mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAudit removes the constraint that every audit row originated from a successful mutation operation. The injected fact forces an orphan audit row (no operation references it), which is exactly the configuration that append-only forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | no op: Operation | op.opAudit = ae }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_SuccessRequiresPermission removes the (role, op) authorisation check. The injection constructs a Member-role caller who is not the owner of the target task yet successfully PATCHes it — exactly the privilege-escalation scenario FR-009 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation, m: Membership | op.opKind = PatchTask and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opAuthenticated = BoolTrue and m.mUser = op.opCaller and m.mTeam = op.opTeamCtx and m.mRole = MemberRole and some op.opTarget and op.opTarget.taskTeam = op.opTeamCtx and op.opTarget.owner != op.opCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CrossTeamIsolation removes the rule that a target task in another team must produce NotFound. The injection forces a successful GetTaskById against a task whose team differs from the caller's X-Team-Id, i.e. a cross-tenant leak.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeak { some op: Operation, m: Membership | op.opKind = GetTaskById and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opAuthenticated = BoolTrue and some op.opTeamCtx and m.mUser = op.opCaller and m.mTeam = op.opTeamCtx and some op.opTarget and op.opTarget.taskTeam != op.opTeamCtx }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuthRequired removes the rule that unauthenticated requests are rejected. The injection forces a Success outcome on an unauthenticated operation, violating FR-001.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation, m: Membership | op.opOutcome = Success and op.opAuthenticated = BoolFalse and some op.opTeamCtx and m.mUser = op.opCaller and m.mTeam = op.opTeamCtx and op.opKind = GetTasksList }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditOnSuccessfulMutation removes the obligation to write an audit entry on a successful mutation. The injection forces a successful PostTasks with no audit row, which is exactly the missing-audit scenario FR-015 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some op: Operation, m: Membership | op.opKind = PostTasks and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opAuthenticated = BoolTrue and some op.opTeamCtx and m.mUser = op.opCaller and m.mTeam = op.opTeamCtx and no op.opAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditAttributionCorrect removes the rule that the audit entry's actor equals the operation's caller. The injection forces an audit entry whose recorded actor differs from the caller — a misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionMismatch { some op: Operation, ae: AuditEntry | op.opAudit = ae and op.opCaller != ae.aeActor }
